sloka: दृष्ट्वा दाशरथिर्लङ्कां चित्रध्वजपताकिनीम् ।जगाम सहसा सीतां दूयमानेन चेतसा ।। ६.४२.७ ।।।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā dāśarathirlaṅkāṁ citradhvajapatākinīm ।jagāma sahasā sītāṁ dūyamānena cetasā ।। 6.42.7 ।।।।

translations.english: The son of Dasaratha saw Lanka decorated with flags and posts and thinking of Sita he became very worried.
